title: Autonomous Internal QA & Playtest Agents
objective: Create internal developer/creator agents that can execute deterministic scenarios and bounded visual/interaction tasks, compare expected state/screens, collect logs/video/performance evidence, minimize/reproduce failures and emit bug bundles. This is not external tester recruitment and creates no SMB-13/BRP distribution authority.

scope.purpose: Provide bounded internal QA/playtest-agent tooling over deterministic scenario and analysis contracts without granting canonical game-state mutation, external testing/distribution or automatic patch authority.
included: log, video and performance evidence collection
scope.completion_gate: Representative internal scenarios can be selected/replayed under governed owner projections, compared against expected state/screens, and reduced to reproducible evidence/bug bundles while canonical mutation and external tester/distribution authority remain outside PCA-14.

selection_boundaries: ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after PCA-13 exact-tree publication. PCA-13 unlocks no new interstitial studio/rotation start; MCS, MCCS and MSAS remain blocked by PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER.
PCA-14 gates PCA-11 and PCA-12 are satisfied; PCA-14 is therefore the lawful next selected item after PCA-13.
PCA-14 is selected only; no implementation branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it.
PCA-12 simulation/formal-analysis outputs may be consumed as internal QA analysis inputs but cannot be upgraded into canonical game state, automatic patches or owner-domain truth.
PCA-11 governed character intelligence remains bounded by its owner/action authority; PCA-14 cannot create unrestricted NPC/GM mutation authority.
SMB-13 and BRP retain external tester, distribution and product-readiness authority; PCA-14 is internal developer/creator QA only.
Detailed deterministic scenario, visual comparison, evidence capture, failure minimization and bug-bundle seams are deferred to governed-start targeted loading rather than guessed at selection time.
PCA-15+, MCS, MCCS, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work are not authorized by this selection.
next_action: Wait for the next owner Continue to governed-start PCA-14. Do not implement PCA-14 while selected_not_started.

stop_reason.evidence: PCA-14 is selected_not_started; no bounded execution is active.
